abstract: A case of persistent Müllerian duct syndrome associated with seminoma is presented. A 28-year-old man was hospitalized with the complaint of a palpable mass in the left lower abdomen and lumbago. Physical examination revealed a normal right scrotal testicle and a small right inguinal hernia that did not contain a mass, but no testicle was found in the left scrotum. Laparotomy was performed for suspected tumor of an intraabdominal testis. At abdominal exploration the left testis was found to be cross-ectopic to just behind the pubic symphysis and to be replaced completely with a large tumor, which was supplied by the left spermatic vessels and had a vas deferens emptied to the right seminal vesicle. In addition another cord-like structure was traced into the right inguinal canal. The tumor was dissected with these structures. On histological examination the tumor was pure seminoma and the cord-like structure proved to be an immature uterus, Fallopian tubes and seminal vesicle.
abstract_ja: 28歳の男性が、左下腹部の触知可能な腫瘤と腰痛を主訴に入院した。身体所見では、右陰嚢精巣は正常であり、右鼠径ヘルニアを認めたが腫瘤は含まれていなかった。一方、左陰嚢内には精巣を認めなかった。腹腔内精巣の腫瘍が疑われ開腹術を施行した。腹腔内の探索で、左精巣は恥骨結合のすぐ後方に交差異所性に位置し、その全体が大きな腫瘍に置換されていた。腫瘍は左精巣動脈から栄養され、輸精管は右精嚢に開口していた。さらに右鼠径管に続く索状構造が認められ、腫瘍とともに切除した。組織学的検査では腫瘍は純粋セミノーマであり、索状構造は未熟子宮、卵管、精嚢であった。
